title: 300mm fab equipment spending to hit US$227 billion by 2029, SEMI says
content: Global spending on 300mm front-end fab equipment is projected to reach US$149 billion in 2026, up 31% from a year earlier. Spending is expected to keep growing at double-digit rates and reach US$227 billion in 2029, SEMI said in its latest 300mm Fab Outlook, released October 13 at SEMICON West in San Francisco.

title: BOE struggles with glass breakage at US$9.4 billion OLED plant as it seeks Apple iPad orders
content: China's BOE has spent approximately six months trying to resolve recurring glass substrate breakage at its Gen 8.6 OLED plant in Chengdu, raising concerns about production stability as the display maker seeks approval to supply panels for Apple's iPads.

title: Tata's flagship chip fab faces pressure from its own shareholders
content: Tata Group's semiconductor fab in Gujarat, held up as the foundation of India's chipmaking ambitions, now faces scrutiny from within, as the group's controlling shareholder presses for quicker returns on capital-intensive bets.

title: AI computing demand drives water management integration at Tianyi
content: Rising AI computing demand is fueling capacity expansion in advanced semiconductor manufacturing, making water recycling, energy efficiency, and smart operations and maintenance key components of the green transformation of high-tech plants. Lealea Group's Tianyi Water & Energy Solutions is integrating water management, renewable power and AI-enabled smart maintenance. title: ASE expands PowerSiP platform to improve AI data center power efficiency
content: ASE has expanded its PowerSiP platform with a 3D system-in-package solution aimed at vertical voltage regulator modules (VRMs) for AI data centers and high-performance computing systems. The move could matter globally as demand for AI infrastructure rises, since more efficient power delivery may help lower energy losses, support denser computing, and ease the strain on rapidly expanding digital infrastructure.

title: Wiwynn unveils CPO compute system with GUC and Ayar Labs
content: Wiwynn Corporation, CPO solutions provider Ayar Labs and Global Unichip Corp. (GUC) will stage the first live demonstration of an integrated compute system with real-time telemetry monitoring at the 2026 OCP Global Summit, marking a new milestone in their strategic partnership.

title: Tsang Yow's semiconductor revenue share reaches 12%
content: Automotive drivetrain manufacturer Tsang Yow reported consolidated revenue of NT$86.36 million (US$2.69 million) in September 2026, down 2.3% month-over-month and 1.24% year-over-year as demand from the Americas aftermarket temporarily slowed. Supported by its semiconductor business, consolidated revenue reached NT$269 million in the third quarter of 2026, up 7.5% year-over-year, while revenue for the first nine months rose 4.04% year-over-year to NT$824 million.

title: Cerebras CEO reveals the capacity shortfall behind OpenAI's turn to Nvidia GPUs
content: Cerebras Systems' shortage of data centre capacity was a key reason OpenAI turned to Nvidia GPUs to expand services for its next-generation models, co-founder and CEO Andrew Feldman said at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026.

title: Kingboard Laminates raises thin-cloth laminates, prepreg prices 15% in eighth hike of 2026
content: Kingboard Laminates Holdings (KB Laminates), a leading Chinese manufacturer, announced its eighth price increase of 2026 on October 13, raising prices by 15% for laminates and prepreg (PP) made with style 2116 or thinner fiberglass fabrics.

title: Ubiqconn satellite revenue jumps 175% as 3Q26 operations recover
content: Ubiqconn Technology reported September 2026 consolidated revenue of NT$142 million (US$4.4 million), up 32.4% month-on-month and 6.7% year-on-year. Third-quarter revenue rose 9.6% sequentially to NT$432 million but fell 10.5% year on year. Revenue for the first three quarters totaled NT$1.373 billion, down 15.7% year on year.

title: Largan chairman casts doubt on Micro LED links for AI data centers
content: Largan Precision chairman En-ping Lin has questioned the viability of Micro LED-based optical links for AI data centers, citing concerns over power consumption, size, and transmission efficiency. Industry sources interviewed by DIGITIMES counter that while individual Micro LEDs transmit data more slowly than lasers, using hundreds of parallel channels could reduce overall system power consumption by simplifying the transmission architecture.

title: SK Hynix HBM4 equipment installations reportedly face partial deferral to 2027
content: Some back-end manufacturing equipment intended for SK Hynix's sixth-generation high-bandwidth memory (HBM4) production may be deferred from the second half of 2026 into 2027, raising questions about the chipmaker's expansion plans as rising conventional DRAM prices create competing opportunities for capital spending.

title: Huawei's Kirin 9050 Pro delivers 53.5% density gain; tighter 3D bonding next for 2027
content: Huawei has begun mass-producing its Kirin 9050 series with LogicFolding, a 3D chip architecture that improves transistor density and computing efficiency without relying solely on smaller process nodes. Its next-generation Kirin chip, scheduled for 2027, has entered testing, with initial results meeting expectations.

title: Microsoft adds US$132.5 billion in lease commitments—but AI capacity takes years to build
content: Microsoft's lease commitments that have not yet commenced reached US$329.1 billion in the fourth quarter of fiscal 2026, which ended in June, according to its latest regulatory filing. The total rose US$132.5 billion, or more than 67%, from the previous quarter, marking the company's largest quarterly increase on record.

title: ASML's record 3Q26 sales expose a capacity gap for AI chip demand through 2028
content: ASML reported record third-quarter 2026 net sales of EUR11.7 billion (approx. US$13.1 billion) and net income of EUR5 billion, while warning that its planned supply for 2027 and 2028 would fall short of customer demand. Growing AI investment is prompting the lithography equipment supplier to explore a larger capacity expansion for 2028, with some customers expressing interest in placing orders for 2029 and 2030.

title: Nvidia's share of China's AI chips falls by a third while Huawei gains
content: Nvidia's share of AI chips in China's data center market has fallen by 34% in the first half of this year, according to a new report. The drop follows months of US restrictions on advanced chip sales to the country, Chinese authorities' push to rely less on Nvidia imports, and domestic players like Huawei moving to fill in this supply gap.

title: Elon Musk says Micron is 'reasonable' on memory prices while others are 'extortionate'
content: Elon Musk has criticized memory chip suppliers for charging what he called "extortionate" prices while praising Micron Technology's approach to future pricing, highlighting tensions between chipmakers and customers as prolonged supply shortages strengthen manufacturers' bargaining power.
